content.title: THE REAL REASON YOUR {{BLOATING}} WON'T GO AWAY
facts: **Fennel seeds** – chew 1 tsp after meals, they relax gut muscles and let trapped gas move through faster.
**Peppermint tea** – 1 cup after dinner calms the intestinal spasms behind that tight, swollen feeling.
**Papaya** – contains papain, an enzyme that breaks down protein your stomach struggles to fully digest.
**Cucumber water** – sip through the day to flush excess sodium that makes you puff up and retain water.
**Asparagus** – acts as a natural diuretic, easing the heavy feeling that comes from water retention.
**Ginger slices** – steep 3-4 slices in hot water, it speeds up stomach emptying so food doesn't sit and ferment.
**Buttermilk** – 1 glass after a heavy meal supplies probiotics that outcompete gas-producing bacteria.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Bloating rarely means something is seriously wrong, it usually means your gut needs a little help moving things along. Fennel seeds work because their natural oils relax the smooth muscle lining your intestines, so gas pockets stop getting stuck and painfully stretching your belly. Papaya is another underrated fix — the papain enzyme it contains actually finishes the protein-breakdown job your stomach acid didn't complete, which means less undigested food sitting around fermenting and producing gas. And ginger speeds up gastric emptying, so meals don't linger in your stomach longer than they should. Everyone's gut reacts a little differently, so pay attention to what actually calms yours down.
